cues.text: On a black, metallic surface, thin lines of fiery orange light trace intricate, angular patterns. The glowing circuits expand to form the stylized shapes of massive spaceships etched into the dark metal.
A silhouetted crowd reaches toward the huge, glowing monolith.
The worshipers hold their arms high.

A towering Vodyani figure of brilliant orange energy and sharp, angular lines stands fully formed against the darkness. It radiates light like a mechanical angel. The blazing apparition pulses with power before fading to black.

beats.note: Glowing orange lines appear on a dark, metallic surface, tracing angular patterns.
The glowing lines form stylized shapes of spaceships.
The perspective pulls back, revealing the surface is a massive angled monolith.
Below the monolith, a large crowd of silhouetted figures raises their arms in worship, outlined by the fiery light.
The scene cuts to another dark surface where a new glowing shape begins to form.
The shape resolves into a humanoid figure, its geometric wings extending outward.
The glowing figure stands fully formed, radiating intense orange light.
